title: Fire Mage / Fury Warrior / Holy Paladin vs Jungle
summary: Kill the Feral. It ends the game on its own — you do not need their healer dead first.

sections.title: The Feral is the game, not a step toward it
sections.body: Counts: Hunter 6, Priest 5, Feral 4. The Feral is thinnest and killing him ends the round — a Hunter and a Priest do not beat this comp on their own. An earlier version argued the healer had to die first because killing the Feral 'only removes one part'. That is wrong in most games and it is the reason this draft was rewritten.

steps.note: 30s. One on the healer, one on a DPS, every 30s.
On the Priest. Different category to the Hammer, so it stacks.
17s root onto the Feral as the Poly lands.

sections.title: The go — off Combustion, every 60 seconds
